facts.fact: MTN's MoMo app opened a wallet corridor from South Africa to the Democratic Republic of Congo, so migrants in South Africa can send money home to wallets there, ITWeb reports.
MTN's MoMo app opened a wallet corridor from South Africa to Mozambique, so migrants in South Africa can send money home to wallets there, ITWeb reports.
MTN's MoMo app opened a wallet corridor from South Africa to Malawi, so migrants in South Africa can send money home to wallets there, ITWeb reports.

MTN South Africa's MoMo app launched 25 additional wallet corridors, letting users in South Africa send money to wallets in Mozambique, Malawi and the Democratic Republic of Congo among others, at a 4% launch fee.
